# generate-grpc — gRPC/Protobuf Schema Generation Skill

Generate proto3 `.proto` service definitions from Linear issue requirements
using the `ProtoGenerator` class. Produce well-structured Protobuf packages
with service/RPC definitions, typed messages, and buf-validated output.

## Generator Interface

```
Module  : src/uptempo/schema/proto.py
Class   : ProtoGenerator(SchemaGenerator)
Methods :
  generate(issue: Issue, workspace: Path) -> list[Path]
  validate(files: list[Path]) -> list[str]
Base    : src/uptempo/schema/base.py — SchemaGenerator
```

## Input

| Field | Source | Description |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| `issue.identifier` | Linear | Issue ID (e.g., `UPT-91`) — embedded in header comment |
| `issue.title` | Linear | Short summary — becomes service name seed |
| `issue.description` | Linear | Full requirements — parse for services, RPCs, messages |
| `workspace` | Orchestrator | Absolute path to `./workspaces/{issue_id}/` |

## Output

```
{workspace}/
└── proto/
    ├── buf.yaml                 # Module config (lint + breaking rules)
    ├── buf.gen.yaml             # Code generation config
    ├── uptempo/
    │   └── {domain}/
    │       └── v1/
    │           ├── {service}.proto       # Service + RPC definitions
    │           ├── {service}_messages.proto  # Request/Response messages
    │           └── common.proto          # Shared enums, types
    └── google/
        └── api/
            └── http.proto       # gRPC-Gateway annotations (if needed)
```

All `.proto` files include the standard header:

```protobuf
// Generated by Uptempo for UPT-91: Order Service gRPC API
```

## Procedure

### Step 1 — Parse Requirements

1. Extract service boundaries from `issue.description` (e.g., "order service", "user service").
2. Identify RPC methods: CRUD operations, queries, commands, subscriptions.
3. Classify streaming patterns per method:
   - Request/response → Unary
   - Real-time feed → Server Streaming
   - Batch upload → Client Streaming
   - Live sync → Bidirectional Streaming
4. Detect target languages: Go, Java, Python, TypeScript → set `option` fields.
5. Note domain entities → become message types.

### Step 2 — Initialize Workspace

```python
from uptempo.schema.proto import ProtoGenerator

generator = ProtoGenerator()
out_dir = workspace / "proto"
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
```

### Step 3 — Create buf Configuration

Generate `buf.yaml` at the proto root:

```yaml
# buf.yaml
version: v2
lint:
  use:
    - STANDARD
    - COMMENTS
  except:
    - PACKAGE_VERSION_SUFFIX
breaking:
  use:
    - FILE
```

Generate `buf.gen.yaml` for codegen targets:

```yaml
# buf.gen.yaml
version: v2
plugins:
  - remote: buf.build/protocolbuffers/go
    out: gen/go
    opt: paths=source_relative
  - remote: buf.build/grpc/go
    out: gen/go
    opt: paths=source_relative
```

### Step 4 — Define Package Structure

Use domain-reversed package names with version suffix:

```protobuf
syntax = "proto3";
package uptempo.{domain}.v1;

option go_package = "github.com/pko89403/uptempo/gen/go/{domain}/v1";
option java_package = "com.uptempo.{domain}.v1";
option java_multiple_files = true;
```

### Step 5 — Generate Message Types

Map domain entities to proto messages:

```protobuf
import "google/protobuf/timestamp.proto";
import "google/protobuf/field_mask.proto";
import "google/protobuf/wrappers.proto";

message Order {
  string id = 1;  // UUID format
  OrderStatus status = 2;
  repeated OrderItem items = 3;
  google.protobuf.Timestamp created_at = 4;
  google.protobuf.Timestamp updated_at = 5;
}

enum OrderStatus {
  ORDER_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
  ORDER_STATUS_PENDING = 1;
  ORDER_STATUS_CONFIRMED = 2;
  ORDER_STATUS_SHIPPED = 3;
  ORDER_STATUS_DELIVERED = 4;
  ORDER_STATUS_CANCELLED = 5;
}

message OrderItem {
  string product_id = 1;
  int32 quantity = 2;
  int64 price_cents = 3;
}
```

Rules:
- Field names: `snake_case`.
- Enum values: `ENUM_TYPE_VALUE` prefix pattern, `_UNSPECIFIED = 0` always first.
- Fields 1–15 for high-frequency fields (1-byte varint tag).
- Use `optional` when absence carries semantic meaning.
- Timestamps: always `google.protobuf.Timestamp`, never `string` or `int64`.

### Step 6 — Generate Service and RPC Definitions

```protobuf
service OrderService {
  // Unary: simple CRUD
  rpc CreateOrder(CreateOrderRequest) returns (CreateOrderResponse);
  rpc GetOrder(GetOrderRequest) returns (GetOrderResponse);
  rpc UpdateOrder(UpdateOrderRequest) returns (UpdateOrderResponse);
  rpc DeleteOrder(DeleteOrderRequest) returns (DeleteOrderResponse);
  rpc ListOrders(ListOrdersRequest) returns (ListOrdersResponse);

  // Server Streaming: real-time order updates
  rpc WatchOrderStatus(WatchOrderStatusRequest) returns (stream OrderStatusEvent);

  // Client Streaming: batch import
  rpc ImportOrders(stream ImportOrderRequest) returns (ImportOrdersResponse);

  // Bidirectional: live order editing
  rpc EditOrderLive(stream EditOrderAction) returns (stream EditOrderUpdate);
}
```

Dedicated request/response per method:

```protobuf
message CreateOrderRequest {
  repeated OrderItem items = 1;
  string customer_id = 2;
}

message CreateOrderResponse {
  Order order = 1;
}

message ListOrdersRequest {
  int32 page_size = 1;
  string page_token = 2;
  string filter = 3;
  string order_by = 4;
}

message ListOrdersResponse {
  repeated Order orders = 1;
  string next_page_token = 2;
  int32 total_count = 3;
}

message UpdateOrderRequest {
  Order order = 1;
  google.protobuf.FieldMask update_mask = 2;
}

message UpdateOrderResponse {
  Order order = 1;
}

message DeleteOrderRequest {
  string id = 1;
}

message DeleteOrderResponse {}
```

### Step 7 — Add gRPC-Gateway Annotations (if REST transcoding needed)

```protobuf
import "google/api/annotations.proto";

service OrderService {
  rpc GetOrder(GetOrderRequest) returns (GetOrderResponse) {
    option (google.api.http) = {
      get: "/api/v1/orders/{id}"
    };
  }

  rpc CreateOrder(CreateOrderRequest) returns (CreateOrderResponse) {
    option (google.api.http) = {
      post: "/api/v1/orders"
      body: "*"
    };
  }
}
```

### Step 8 — Add Error Detail Types

Use the standard `google.rpc` error model:

```protobuf
import "google/rpc/status.proto";
import "google/rpc/error_details.proto";

// Error responses use google.rpc.Status with details:
// - google.rpc.BadRequest for validation errors
// - google.rpc.PreconditionFailure for state violations
// - google.rpc.ErrorInfo for machine-readable error codes
```

### Step 9 — Write Files

```python
files = generator.generate(issue, workspace)
```

### Step 10 — Validate

```python
errors = generator.validate(files)
# Runs buf lint + buf breaking
```

## Output Template

Minimal valid single-service proto:

```protobuf
// Generated by Uptempo for UPT-91: Order Service gRPC API
syntax = "proto3";
package uptempo.orders.v1;

option go_package = "github.com/pko89403/uptempo/gen/go/orders/v1";
option java_package = "com.uptempo.orders.v1";
option java_multiple_files = true;

import "google/protobuf/timestamp.proto";
import "google/protobuf/field_mask.proto";

// OrderService manages the order lifecycle.
service OrderService {
  // Create a new order.
  rpc CreateOrder(CreateOrderRequest) returns (CreateOrderResponse);
  // Retrieve an order by ID.
  rpc GetOrder(GetOrderRequest) returns (GetOrderResponse);
  // List orders with pagination and filtering.
  rpc ListOrders(ListOrdersRequest) returns (ListOrdersResponse);
  // Update an existing order (partial update via FieldMask).
  rpc UpdateOrder(UpdateOrderRequest) returns (UpdateOrderResponse);
  // Delete an order by ID.
  rpc DeleteOrder(DeleteOrderRequest) returns (DeleteOrderResponse);
  // Stream real-time order status changes.
  rpc WatchOrderStatus(WatchOrderStatusRequest) returns (stream OrderStatusEvent);
}

enum OrderStatus {
  ORDER_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
  ORDER_STATUS_PENDING = 1;
  ORDER_STATUS_CONFIRMED = 2;
  ORDER_STATUS_SHIPPED = 3;
  ORDER_STATUS_DELIVERED = 4;
  ORDER_STATUS_CANCELLED = 5;
}

message Order {
  string id = 1;
  OrderStatus status = 2;
  string customer_id = 3;
  repeated OrderItem items = 4;
  google.protobuf.Timestamp created_at = 5;
  google.protobuf.Timestamp updated_at = 6;
}

message OrderItem {
  string product_id = 1;
  int32 quantity = 2;
  int64 price_cents = 3;
}

message CreateOrderRequest {
  string customer_id = 1;
  repeated OrderItem items = 2;
}
message CreateOrderResponse { Order order = 1; }

message GetOrderRequest { string id = 1; }
message GetOrderResponse { Order order = 1; }

message ListOrdersRequest {
  int32 page_size = 1;
  string page_token = 2;
}
message ListOrdersResponse {
  repeated Order orders = 1;
  string next_page_token = 2;
}

message UpdateOrderRequest {
  Order order = 1;
  google.protobuf.FieldMask update_mask = 2;
}
message UpdateOrderResponse { Order order = 1; }

message DeleteOrderRequest { string id = 1; }
message DeleteOrderResponse {}

message WatchOrderStatusRequest { string order_id = 1; }
message OrderStatusEvent {
  string order_id = 1;
  OrderStatus previous_status = 2;
  OrderStatus new_status = 3;
  google.protobuf.Timestamp changed_at = 4;
}
```

## Validation Rules

| Rule | Tool | Severity |
|------|------|----------|
| Valid proto3 syntax | `buf lint` | error |
| `STANDARD` lint category passes | `buf lint --config buf.yaml` | error |
| `COMMENTS` lint — services and RPCs have doc comments | `buf lint` | warn |
| Enum zero value is `_UNSPECIFIED` | buf `ENUM_ZERO_VALUE_SUFFIX` | error |
| No breaking changes vs prior version | `buf breaking --against .git#branch=main` | error |
| Request/Response names follow `{Method}Request`/`{Method}Response` | buf `RPC_REQUEST_RESPONSE_UNIQUE` | error |
| Package matches directory structure | buf `PACKAGE_DIRECTORY_MATCH` | error |
| Header comment present | `_header_comment()` check | error |

Run validation:

```bash
buf lint {workspace}/proto/ --config {workspace}/proto/buf.yaml
buf breaking {workspace}/proto/ --against .git#branch=main
```

## Error Handling

| Condition | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| No services found in issue | Generate single `{Domain}Service` with CRUD RPCs, mark `x-generated: placeholder` |
| Streaming pattern ambiguous | Default to Unary, add comment with streaming alternative |
| Target language not specified | Include `go_package` and `java_package` defaults |
| Circular message references | Break cycle with `string` ID references, document in comments |
| Field number conflicts | Auto-assign sequential numbers, warn if reassignment detected |
| Missing domain types | Infer from RPC names, mark with `// x-inferred` comment |
| buf lint failure | Return errors from `validate()`, do not delete generated files |
| buf breaking changes detected | Return detailed migration guide in error messages |
| Workspace directory missing | Create `proto/` directory tree automatically |
